title: Module review
subtitle: Everything from Spain and Portugal
objectives: Explain Spain's ageing and quality system
Link Iberian regions to their grapes
Compare north and south in both countries

steps.prompt: Order Spain's red ageing categories from youngest to oldest.
steps.explanation: Each category requires more time in oak and bottle.

steps.prompt: Match each region to its main grape.
steps.explanation: Iberia's regions each have their own identity.
Llicorella forces roots deep and keeps yields tiny.

steps.prompt: In the Alentejo, Tempranillo is called Aragonez.
steps.explanation: Yes. In the Douro it's Tinta Roriz; in Spain, Tempranillo or Tinto Fino.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Spain's ageing terms run from Joven to Gran Reserva
Rioja and Priorat are Spain's DOCa regions
Green Iberia makes fresh whites; the plateau and the south make ripe reds
Portugal's native grapes give it a unique identity
